name: Whorl 55
notes: Fingerprint eddies, polished burl, turbulence: the corduroy spectrum under a stronger, coarser warp. The eddies survive along a stroke on the rigid train and dissolve into uniform hatching on the deep one - this family is where that was measured. TONAL dual-gate: the mask is the tone-mapped field itself, so the stroke carries the texture as graded alpha and the level number is the damage/modulation DEPTH. Rides the SHALLOW RIGID train (dual scatter 0.2, spacing 0.28, n=3) because the warp makes its curves PHASE structure, and a deep train averages independent windows and blends curves away. Measured both ways on this family: three-quarters more delivered contrast on the rigid train at equal ripple (docs/spectral-atlas.md §4). tonal.gain 1.7 is the shallower train's compensation. Tip from tips/whorl.spec.json; audited by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
